The Router's visual observation of the tail 'floating' or lacking a clear anchor is a strong indicator of AI structural failure in attaching thin appendages to furry bodies. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 1.5) regarding repetitive/painted fur is also consistent with common diffusion artifacts where micro-detail is lost in favor of pattern repetition. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these because they are structural/semantic, not just noise/blur. I agree with the Router's severity assessments; the tail issue is a moderate structural defect.
